cases.name: Patricia Louise Duff
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Pat was a very devoted person to anyone in need of a little help. She was a very dedicated mother and daughter to her parents who she helped care for. Pat enjoyed laughing and always enjoyed listening to music. Being outdoors was also an essential part of her life. Pat always took a bad situation and turned it into a positive experience. "
